The main plate holds what looks like scrambled egg whites, about 200 g. At roughly 52 kcal per 100 g, that is about 105 kcal.

A second plate at the left edge is partly visible. It holds roasted sweet potato or carrot pieces, some dark grapes, and possibly a piece of sausage. I estimated about 100 g of that, which adds roughly 120 kcal.

Combined, that is about 300 g of food and about 225 kcal.
